title: Tick-shell Gauntlets
summary: Something to carry the grip in, forged from chalkbone and what the ticks leave behind.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work chalkbone bar and tick shells into a pair of gauntlets, to go with the cleaver and the plate.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking bone tick shells, for anyone who would rather buy than dig them out of a tick.

items.name: Tick-shell gauntlets
items.examine: Plates off a tick shell, strapped down where the wrist takes the worst of it.
